name: Homelab
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: Status board for homelab services from a Dashy config or the App settings, with mDNS support for .local hosts.

HOMELAB_SERVICES.label: Services
HOMELAB_SERVICES.description: Optional, instead of Dashy. JSON such as {"Server": {"Gitea": "http://pi.local:8124"}}, or text like: Server: Gitea=http://pi.local:8124, Beszel=http://pi.local:8090; NAS: UGOS=http://192.168.1.10:9999

DASHY_URL.label: Dashy URL
DASHY_URL.description: Dashy address such as http://raspberrypi.local:4000, or a direct link to any Dashy-format YAML or JSON config. Ignored when Services is set.

CHECK_INTERVAL.label: Check interval (seconds)
CHECK_INTERVAL.description: How often every service is checked. Minimum 5.

CHECK_TIMEOUT.label: Check timeout (seconds)
CHECK_TIMEOUT.description: How long to wait for a service before marking it down.
